main_text.head: ARGVMENTA CAPITVM.
Cap. I
main_text.p: Hæc scribo,qui sum cœlesti voce vocatus, Qui veram docui,dogmata sancta,fidem. Miror,quæ levitas animos perturbet inanes, Vt cadat è vano tam cito corde fides. Cum, mea quæ docui,non sint mortalia verba, Qui docuit,Dominus nempe magister erat.
2 Non me discipuli docuerunt dogmata sancta, Quin potius testor me docuisse Petrum. Namque is sollicito servabat pectore legem, Cum vos sola queat iustificare fides.
3 Quis vos ô[?] stulti Galatæ seduxit in illum Errorem, vt fidei non pia cura siet? Sola fides sanctum Domino coniunxit Abramum. Hinc, cur sit Legis tradita forma, docet.
4 Libertas quæ sit fidei, quæ regula legis Edocet, & reprobos increpat inde viros. Indicat illorum quam sit fœdissimus error. Lex nos constringit, liberat alma fides.
5 Libera nunc fidei cœlestis iura tenete: Sin minus: hei vobis Christus inanis erit. Pœna manet falsos, qui vos seducere tentans. Sit pietatis amor, sit superata caro[?].
6 Clementer (moneo) lapsos attollite fratres. Sanctus amor vigeat, gloria vana cadat. Doctores colite, & fidei constantia vobis Adsit: sit Christus gloria vestra simul.
main_text.head: ALITER.
Cap. I
main_text.p: Angelus his dicens contraria sit maledictus. Me docuit Christus, qui populator erat.
2 Bis septem exactis repeto Solymos, rogo summos, Qui nihil addebant, corripioque Petrum.
3 Cæpistis recte; quis vos decepit amici? Sic nos non legem iustificare probo.

page.notes: Printed page 258; running head "S. PAVLI AD GALATAS." Initial H and A are woodcut-style large letters, joined to their words. The marks "ô" in stanza 3 and "caro" in stanza 5 are doubtful: the scan is faint there. The printed "cato" in stanza 5 was read as "caro" with [?]. Verse numbers 2–6 are the stanza numbers printed at the left margin, not notes.
